About

Incorporated in 1991, Cords Cable Industries Ltd is engaged in manufacturing Power Cables (upto 3.3 kV), Control Cables, and Instrumentation Cables.[1]

Key Points

Product Profile & Application:
a) Thermocouple Cables:[1]
Used to extend thermocouple circuits from the sensor to the reference unit
b) Control & Electrical Wiring Cables:[2]
Interconnection of process control, communication, and panel control systems, electric power, lighting & internal wiring
c) Instrumentation, Signal and Data Cables:[3]
Data acquisition systems, computer networking, PA systems, digital control/measuring and communication systems, and transmit signals without any external interference
d) Power Cables:[4]
Power supply to residential, commercial & industrial units
e) Special Cables:[5]
1) Fieldbus Cables
2) FireSave - Fire Survival Cables
3) EPR Cables
4) XtremeTemp - Low Temprature Cables
5) Flexible Cable
6) LowTox - Fire Retardant Low Smoke Cables
7) ToxFree - Low Smoke Zero Halogen Cables
8) Oil Resist Cable
9) Super Oil Resist Cable
10) Railway Jelly Filled Quad Cable
11) Eurobalise Railway Safety Cable
